patterns.note: Full-bleed, highly detailed illustrative hero image that spans a significant vertical height, acting as a visual anchor for the page.
Hero background image parallaxes upwards, revealing more of the fantastical landscape, while initial hero text fades out and new call-to-action content fades in at a specific scroll depth.
Elegant, large-scale serif typography for primary headings, contrasted with clean, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation, creating a sophisticated visual hierarchy.

A dominant cool palette of blues and purples derived from the hero illustration, complemented by a very light, almost white, background for content sections, and subtle pastel accents within content cards.

Content is organized into distinct, card-based grid sections (e.g., 'Parables making in the future,' 'Prior Investments') that use a consistent structure of a category label, title, and brief description.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a large, full-bleed video or image that parallaxes against the scroll, with multiple layers of text and interactive elements appearing and disappearing at different scroll thresholds, likely orchestrated with GSAP ScrollTrigger.
The navigation bar transitions from a transparent state with light text to a sticky, solid dark background with light text after the initial scroll, providing clear contrast against content.
Content sections below the hero are revealed with a staggered fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement and guiding the user's eye down the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif hero heading (~4-5x body) with smaller, clean sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy hero section, balanced spacing in content sections with clear visual separation between elements within cards and grid items.

standout: The site's distinctive feature is its highly detailed, fantastical, and illustrative hero imagery, which creates an immersive and unique visual experience. This is combined with elegant, large-scale serif typography and a narrative structure of 'Parables' and 'Philosophies' that elevates the content beyond a typical corporate site.
